page.notes: Doubtful: "doctiâ" (line 1) may be read differently; the word is partly obscured. Underlined "Quare" in the original is plain here. The word at the right edge of "eos summum esse" is partly covered by a smudge and is uncertain. The right edge of the scan cuts several line ends (e.g., "qua", "ut", "nimi-"), and the neighbouring page's edge is visible at the far right; these were not transcribed. The catchword "gere" is at bottom right.
